jobs.description: Job descriptionWe are currently looking for a Senior HR Generalist join our international HR Department, and provide support to our offices in Germany. The post-holder is responsible to provide a robust HR service and support to the Human Resources Department’s daily operations: personnel administration, benefits, payroll etc. He/she mainly works within a framework of established HR processes, procedures and standard work instructions as determined by the centralised HR department and applicable local country legislations.- Be responsible for all aspect of the administration involved in the employee life cycle including procedures in TransPerfect’s offices in Germany- Partner with the recruitment and relevant department to best coordinate employees’ onboarding- Gather required onboarding and separation paperwork in line with local regulations and Company procedures and policies- Manage employees’ absence and leave and coordinate submission of necessary documentation for payroll-  Coordinate relevant training programs- Support the implementation and monitoring of performance evaluation programs- Implement and localize personnel policies and procedures and maintain compliance with country regulations- Have a robust understanding and practical knowledge of Company processes and policies to advise employees and managers- Manage the processes for relocations and transfers including necessary visa applications, payroll transfers, etc.- Maintain and implement HRIS and employee file integrity- Run and create standard reporting from HRIS (turnover, benefits, etc.)- Administer different benefit plans in compliance with local regulations and Company procedures and policies- Support and advise on employee relations procedures e.g., grievances and disciplinaries. This could involve arranging meetings and taking notes- Perform operational support to the different office(s) in Germany- Complete all other tasks that are deemed appropriate for your role and assigned by your manager/supervisorJob requirements- Minimum 4 years HR experience within a multinational company- Minimum Bachelor’s degree or its equivalent, preferably with specialization in Human Resources- Proficiency level in MS Office (specifically Excel)- Excellent English communication skills (written and verbal)- Excellent German communication skills (written and verbal)- General knowledge and understanding of benefits/compensation- Ability to maintain professionalism and confidentiality in all situations- Ability to handle sensitive information in a confidential manner- Positive attitude, resiliency, and the ability to produce high quality and volume at a fast pace- Ability to work effectively and independently across organizational boundaries- Attention to detail, problem-solving competencies- Working knowledge with HRIS- Problem solving and analytical skills- Maintain flexibility to take on additional responsibilities, as neededWe kindly ask you to submit your CV in english language please.Ergänzende Informationen:Homeoffice:Umfang: Nach VereinbarungAnforderungen an den Bewerber: Erweiterte Kenntnisse: Lohn-, Gehalts-, Tarifwesen, Bildungsmanagement, -planung, Personalunterlagen erstellen, Controlling, Personalverwaltung, Personalentwicklung

jobs.occupation: Senior Cost and Value Engineer (w/m/d) for Value Management in Product and Software Business (Ingenieur/in - Elektrotechnik)
jobs.description: Is it your passion to optimize value across portfolios, systems and products within a global Cost and Value Engineering function? Then join our team as a Senior Cost and Value Engineer for Value Management and Value Engineering (f/m/d) and actively drive sustainable value optimizations in a cross-functional environment at Siemens AG.What we offer you- 2 to 3 days of mobile working per week as a global standard- Development opportunities for both personal and professional growth - 30 leave days and a variety of flexible working models that allow time off for yourself and your family - Share matching programs to become a shareholder of Siemens AG- Appealing Siemens pension benefitsSince each of over 300,000 team members feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here (https://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs/benefits-what-we-offer.html) .The individual benefits are subject to regulatory, contractual, or corporate conditions.You’ll make an impact by- Leading and supporting Cost and Value Engineering (CVE) projects within Siemens AG with a focus on Value Management and Value Engineering:- You are responsible for leading value optimization projects in CVE (e.g., Value Benchmarking), in close collaboration with cross-functional teams to systematically improve the value of portfolios, systems and products.- You act as an expert for value improvement and interdependencies in ecosystems, portfolios and systems, and support our businesses in strategic projects.- You contribute your expertise in hardware/software-combined portfolios and systems to maximize business value holistically, considering customer requirements, technical feasibility and economic impacts.- Consistent further development of Value Management and Value Engineering methods in Cost and Value Engineering:- You continuously further develop methods in Value Management and Value Engineering and ensure their consistent integration with existing CVE methods (e.g., Value Analysis, Requirements Engineering, CVE Benchmarking).- You develop Value Management methods to make interdependencies across ecosystems, portfolios, systems and products, as well as their lifecycle business impact, transparent.- You develop quantitative value approaches to evaluate and optimize hardware/software-combined portfolios and systems.- You further develop and maintain an AI-based Value Management knowledge base for the CVE community.- Partner for Portfolio and Product Management and the CVE community:- You act as partner for Portfolio and Product Management functions within Siemens AG to identify and initiate CVE projects.- You promote value-driven thinking across Cost and Value Engineering and relevant business functions.- You are part of the CVE community as expert for Value Management and Value Engineering methods.Your success is grounded in- Education: A university degree with a technical or software-related background, e.g., industrial engineering, engineering, computer science or related fields.- Experience & Skills:- You have many years of professional experience in portfolio management, product management, value management or in comparable functions such as sales, business development or business-centric system architect.- You have a sound understanding of Value Management and/or Value Engineering, such as Value Analysis or similar approaches.- You have practical experience in optimizing systems and products, ideally in building technologies, electrical engineering or energy distribution.- You have a solid understanding of AI applications and how Value Management knowledge can be made accessible through AI-based solutions.- Ideally, you have already gained initial experience working with Cost and Value Engineering and/or Procurement Engineers.- Ways of working:- You have strong analytical and conceptual thinking skills and can quickly understand complex structures and interdependencies.- You bring a strategic and customer-centric mindset and can translate complex business challenges into sustainable value creation opportunities.- You manage projects and time effectively, facilitate workshops professionally, and support acquisition activities with confidence.- Knowledge of Siemens products and systems in Smart Infrastructure is an advantage.- Willingness to occasionally travel, approx. 20%.- Languages: You have excellent German and English skills, both written and spoken.You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!At Siemens, we believe that feeling valued and included is the foundation for doing great work. That’s why we aim to create an inclusive workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging, and where individual perspectives and experiences are celebrated. Our commitment to fairness and respect extends to every applicant.As an equal opportunity employer (http://www.siemens.com/global/en/company/sustainability/social-commitments/belonging.html) , we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities.About usEvery day at Siemens, thousands of processes take place involving the ordering, processing, storage, and delivery of a wide variety of materials, raw materials, and products. Our Supply Chain experts keep a close eye on every movement from A to B. How can our digital processes help us operate more efficiently, effectively, and adaptively? What challenges and opportunities do we see in shaping a sustainable future worldwide? Join us in finding the answers to these questions!www.siemens.de/careers (http://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs.html) – if you would like to find out more about jobs & careers at Siemens.FAQ (https://www.siemens.com/en-us/company/jobs/faq/)  – if you need further information on the application process.

At HelloFresh, our mission is simple: to change the way people eat, forever. As a global digital-native FMCG company and the world's leading mealkit provider, we are transforming the traditional food supply chain through a data-driven, on-demand model that enables scalable and more sustainable food delivery. The HelloFresh Group includes eight brands serving customers across multiple meal occasions, including HelloFresh, Green Chef, EveryPlate, and Chefs Plate, as well as ready-to-eat meals from Factor and YouFoodz, meat and seafood subscriptions through Good Chop, and pet nutrition with The Pets Table. Through technology, data, and culinary innovation, we deliver personalized food experiences to millions of households worldwide.The roleThis is a Mid-Level strategic procurement role and you'll own a portfolio of indirect categories (Facilities Management [FM], MRO and  Utilities, MRO) across HelloFresh's European production sites, designing and executing category strategies that deliver real P&L impact. You'll be a trusted partner to Operations, Engineering, and Finance leadership, shaping how HelloFresh invests in and runs its production network. The role reports to the Director Indirect Procurement.Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.What you’ll do- Design and execute category strategies: spend analysis, market intelligence, supplier landscape assessments, and sourcing roadmaps- Lead complex RFx events and negotiate high-value contracts delivering TCO savings,not just unit price reductions- Build and manage preferred supplier portfolio per category: qualification, KPIs, and continuous improvement- Partner with senior stakeholders in Operations, Engineering, and Finance across multiple European markets- Translate business needs into procurement strategies proactively.- Drive governance and best-practice adoption: contract management, supplier risk, and compliance- Present category strategies and sourcing outcomes clearly to Director and VP-level audiences- Support broader Procurement Ops team, if necessary, in CapEx, MHE, etc. projects.What you’ll bring- 5+ years in indirect or operations procurement, with genuine category depth, not surface-level exposure- Multi-category experience in an operations or manufacturing environment (FM, MRO,, Utilities, etc.); the broader and deeper, the stronger the profile- Proven strategic sourcing skills: RFx design, complex negotiation, and contract structuring for technically complex purchases- Track record of influencing and building trust with senior, cross-functional stakeholders across European markets- Fluent in English; German and/or French language skills are a plus- Strong analytical mindset:spend data, cost modelling, benchmarking, and business case development- Able to travel to production sites across Europe, if required.Please submit your resume in English.What we offerElevate your lifestyle! Join one of Europe's fastest-growing tech powerhouses in a dynamic phase of expansion.- Initially we offer 2 years contract.- Immerse yourself in a diverse global community of 90+ nationalities.- Enjoy a competitive compensation package that goes beyond the norm, with perks like a HelloFresh- subsidized Pension Scheme, Berlin relocation support, and a Hybrid working model.- Elevate your lifestyle with exclusive discounts on your weekly HelloFresh box and office meals.- Invest in your growth with an annual learning & development budget, German language learning budget, and access to the HelloFresh Academy.- Plus, we've got your well-being covered with mental health support, transportation perks, and working-parent-friendly benefits. From our 24/7 gym access,wellbeing platforms like Headspace and Spill, to sabbatical leave options, HelloFresh is not just a workplace; it's a lifestyle of perks and possibilities!Are you up for the challenge?Please submit your complete application below including your salary expectations and earliest starting date.After submitting an application our team will review this and get back to you within 5 business days.Ergänzende Informationen:Homeoffice:Umfang: Nach VereinbarungAnforderungen an den Bewerber: Expertenkenntnisse: Einkauf, Beschaffung

jobs.occupation: Manager Operations Planning (f/m/d) 80% - 100% Operations Center Neuenburg 1 (Supply-Chain-Manager/in)
jobs.description: Manager Operations Planning (f/m/d)- Operations Center Neuenburg 1- 80% - 100%- Supply Chain Management- EnglischAs the top Swiss e-commerce platform, with a crew of over 4’000 across Switzerland, Germany, and Serbia, Galaxus is poised to move into new markets. Our driving force is our determination to keep challenging the status quo. That’s why we’re on the lookout for characters who’re passionate about making genuine improvements. We’ll give you the freedom and trust to make an impact, to grow with us and to be yourself. Act galactic. Be you.As our Manager Operations Planning, you're the person who makes sure the right people are in the right place at the right time. You build and run the labour planning system for our logistics site in Neuenburg, turning data into weekly plans that keep operations running smoothly. Your work sits at the crossroads of analytics, operational coordination, and project delivery.Deine Aufgaben- Design and operate the site's labour planning system, built on historic productivity data, attendance patterns, and volume forecasts- Deliver a detailed weekly staffing plan and maintain a rolling 21-day capacity outlook, adjusting for volume shifts, planned downtime, and staff availability- When gaps appear, you identify and activate short-term capacity levers — fixes that work now without creating headaches later- Analyse seasonal volume trends and connect them with hiring lead times to build ramp-up plans for peak periods- Prepare analyses, calculations, and decision material for the Site Lead: translating data into recommendations that are clear enough to act on- Own small and medium-sized logistics projects from start to finish and contribute to larger cross-functional initiatives- Keep stakeholders in the loop with regular, structured updates on KPIs, productivity, and capacity utilisation. No one likes surprises when it comes to numbersDeine Fähigkeiten- A degree from a university or university of applied sciences (Universität/Fachhochschule) in a relevant field, or equivalent further education combined with experience in workforce planning, demand forecasting, or supply chain management- Strong analytical skills, ideally backed by relevant training or certifications. You're comfortable building planning models and translating data into actionable insights- Hands-on experience in project management, ideally in logistics or infrastructure projects.- Fluent written and spoken German and English- Confident use of Excel and planning or BI tools. Experience with warehouse management systems or workforce scheduling tools is a plus- You're solution-oriented, pragmatic, and a natural organiser. Your communication style is confident, open, and adapted to your audience- Identifying opportunities for improvement and implementing changes to enhance productivity and effectiveness- Maintaining resilience and agility while adjusting strategies as neededWarum startest du bei uns?- Values, not empty words: Cooperative, innovative, piratesque, responsible, ambitious – these five values are what we practice and preach.- Courageous thinking: We encourage everyone to think on their feet, and love it when they come up with bold or edgy ideas.- Uncomplicated approach: Simplicity is at our core. We avoid the unnecessary and focus on what really matters – from overcoming challenges to celebrating our shared successes.- Flexibility and freedom: We offer working-from-home options, up to 8 weeks of workation, and every position is possible with an 80% workload.- Rapid growth: With us, growth is a continuous journey. We also support you with EDU Points (1600 € or 2000 minutes) (https://www.galaxus.de/de/page/einmal-weiterbildung-bitte-20943)  per year for your professional development so there’s no risk of you getting stuck in a rut.- More benefits: 28 days of holiday, exclusive employee conditions in our online shop, a shuttle service and other benefits.Diversity is our culture.To build the best team, we want to draw from the full spectrum of talent out there. This means people from all walks of life have the same opportunities with us, regardless of their ethnicity, religion, disability status, gender identity, sexual orientation or age. We believe true inclusion means everyone is welcome and each contribution is valuable.

As a business partner to Siemens executive management,we leverage our expertise in a wide range of topics to create an impact thatdrives change. Weinvest in our expertise and therefore provide continuous career coaching,trainings and mentoring, all whilst working with top Siemens business leaderson multiple high-profile projects around the world.Our Cybersecurity teamprovides core assurance over the Cybersecurity health of the company whichincludes IT and OT infrastructures, product security, software development andcloud environments. We are on the lookout for people with a great skillset, aninternational mindset and new ideas who understand Siemens businesses and howCybersecurity helps enable and increase market value. Are you one ofthem?To discover more about the global Siemens assurance function FIN A click here (https://assets.new.siemens.com/siemens/assets/api/uuid:832d2c5d-e30c-4163-a1be-9fa3d67f645b/controlling-and-finance-assurance-info-for-applicants.pdf)What part will you play?- As valuable member of the assurance teamyou will be responsible for conducting Cybersecurity assessments acrossthe entire Siemens landscape, including products, services, IT-systems,factories, and software development centers. During this process you willperform ethical hacking activities, design attack scenarios forstate-of-the-art technologies and highlight important observations totranslate technical findings into management information so that they cantake effective actions.- Apply hacking principles and red teammethodologies, tools and techniques to mimic real-world threat behaviorsfaced by the Siemens’s digital environment, e.g. cloud applications,on-premise infrastructure, digital products and services.- You work closely with cybersecurityexperts from multiple industries to improve their solutions by tacklingthe root cause of the issues and find innovative solutions to modernchallenges.- You independently conduct research onlatest developments in Cybersecurity technologies and threats andunderstand how this is impacting and changing the Siemens’ environment.What you need to make real what matters- Strong academic history (Bachelor degree)in IT, Computer Science or other related fields; certifications such asGIAC GPEN,  OSCP, CRTP, eJPT, CREST, etc. are a plus.- Good scripting and programming skills andexperience with languages such as Bash, Python,  Powershell, andC++ / C#.- 2+ years of professional full-time workingexperience within Siemens or a related industry in penetration testing /red teaming with a proven record of continuous career development.- Demonstrated affinity to learn about thelatest trends in cybersecurity and keep up to date in a continuouslychallenging environment.- You have first experience with one or moreof the following aspects of penetration testing / red teaming: applicationand software security, EDR and antivirus evasion, C2 setup, automation andscaling of security testing, Active Directory attacks, etc.- Demonstrated first experience in capturethe flag (CTFs) events, bug hunting or vulnerability research (CVEs) is aplus.- Experience with leveraging and integrating AI into day-to-day workis considered an advantage.- Fluent in English. German or otherlanguages are a plus.- You demonstrate an international mindsetand are open to international travel, and working in a diverse team.Whilecommitment to our job improves performance, growth happens when we stretchbeyond our comfort zone. FIN A offers ample of opportunities to seek thechallenge:Caring forthe world around us is a crucial part of our working culture at FIN A for over adecade.Everyone at FIN A has the possibility to actively engage in our globalCSR community and make an impact with our socially and environmentally motivedCSR projects.What we offer- 2 to 3 days of mobile working per week as a future global standard- An environment where everyone can bring their whole self to work and feel a sense of belonging- 30 leave days and a variety of flexible working models that allow time off for yourself and your family - Share matching programs to become a shareholder of Siemens AG- Pension plan to ensure financial security - 50+ learning hours per year for both personal and professional growthAny questions left?Click here (https://siemens-my.sharepoint.com/personal/liuyan_siemens_com/Documents/DataBackup250210/D/Arbeit/CFA/CSA/JD/Cyber%20Process%20Auditor%20ERA12.docx)  if you wish to find out more about Siemens before applying.As an equal-opportunity employer weare happy to consider applications from individuals with disabilities (https://www.siemens.com/de/de/home/unternehmen/jobs/arbeiten-bei-siemens/jobs-ohne-barrieren.html) .
